notes.subject: הרע תרעו
notes.rationale: Infinitive absolute plus finite verb of the same root רעע — 'evil-ing ye shall evil' — intensification lost in Maltese

notes.subject: tittneħħaw
notes.rationale: ספה literally 'to sweep/scrape away, snatch away'; rendered as 'removed' rather than the literal picture

notes.subject: lill-Jisrael
notes.rationale: Samuel addresses Israel directly in the farewell speech, conditionell maħrub mill-attended covenant

notes.subject: is-sultan
notes.rationale: Warning li anki s-sultan maħtur (Saul) jaqa' taħt l-istess ġudizzju — l-ewwel darba li l-monarkija nnifsha hija taħt il-patt

translation: Iżda jekk tagħmlu l-ħażen, kemm intom kemm is-sultan tagħkom tittneħħaw kollkom.
